info.name: AgriFleet API
info.description:
Complete API collection for AgriFleet - Agriculture Machinery & Operations Management System.

## Setup
1. Import this collection
2. Import `AgriFleet.postman_environment.json`
3. Select **AgriFleet - Local** environment
4. Run **Login** first — access_token & refresh_token are saved automatically
5. All other requests use `{{access_token}}` via collection-level Bearer auth

## Roles
- `owner` — full access
- `supervisor` — create/update most resources
- `accountant` — finance & payroll read/write
- `driver` — read-only on most resources

## Base URL
`http://localhost:8080/api/v1`

request.description:
Login with phone + password. Automatically saves access_token and refresh_token to environment.

Required fields:
- `phone` (string)
- `password` (string, min 6 chars)
Exchange a refresh token for a new token pair. Old refresh token is rotated (invalidated).
Returns the authenticated user's ID and role from the JWT claims.
Invalidates the provided refresh token. Access token remains valid until expiry.

List all machines with optional filters.

Query params:
- `status`: active | idle | maintenance | retired
- `type`: harvester | tractor | truck | loader | other
- `page`, `page_size`

body.raw:
{
  "name": "John Deere S780",
  "type": "harvester",
  "model": "S780",
  "year": 2022,
  "reg_number": "KCA 001A",
  "current_location": "Farm A, Nakuru",
  "notes": "Primary harvester for wheat season"
}

request.description:
Create a new machine. Requires `owner` or `supervisor` role.

Required: `name`, `type`, `reg_number`
Type values: harvester | tractor | truck | loader | other
Get a single machine with full details.

Update machine details. Requires `owner` or `supervisor` role.

Status values: active | idle | maintenance | retired
Soft-delete a machine. Requires `owner` role only.
Record daily working hours for a machine. `operator_id` defaults to the authenticated user.
Paginated list of daily logs for a specific machine.

Link a user account to a driver profile. Requires `owner` or `supervisor` role.

Required: `user_id` (UUID), `license_number`, `license_expiry` (YYYY-MM-DD)

Create a field worker. Requires `owner` or `supervisor` role.

Required: `name`, `daily_wage` (≥0)

Mark attendance for one or more workers in a single request.

Status values: present | absent | half_day | on_leave

Wage is auto-calculated: present = full daily_wage, half_day = daily_wage/2

Calculate payroll for all workers in a date range. Requires `owner` or `accountant` role.

Both `from` and `to` are required (YYYY-MM-DD).

Record a fuel fill-up. `total_cost` is auto-calculated as `liters × cost_per_liter`.

Required: `machine_id`, `date`, `liters` (>0), `cost_per_liter` (>0)
Requires `owner` or `accountant` role.
Aggregated fuel consumption and cost analytics per machine for the given period. Defaults to last 30 days.

body.raw:
{
  "machine_id": "{{machine_id}}",
  "type": "scheduled",
  "date": "2026-06-01",
  "description": "Annual engine service and oil change",
  "cost": 45000,
  "next_due_date": "2027-06-01",

  "notes": "Replaced air filter and spark plugs"
}

request.description:
Log a maintenance event. Status defaults to `pending`.

Required: `machine_id`, `type`, `date`, `description`
Type values: scheduled | breakdown | preventive

  "cost": 48000,
  "next_due_date": "2027-06-01",
  "technician": "John Kamau",

}

request.description: Returns maintenance records with `next_due_date` within the specified number of days.
Returns maintenance records where `next_due_date` has passed and status is not completed.

Create a new spare part / consumable. Requires `owner` or `supervisor` role.

Required: `name` (min 2 chars)
Requires `owner` or `supervisor` role.

Add stock for a spare part. `current_stock` is incremented automatically.

Required: `quantity` (>0)

Deduct stock. Returns 400 if insufficient stock.

Required: `quantity` (>0)
Returns all spare parts where `current_stock` ≤ `min_stock_level`.
Full audit trail of all stock-in and stock-out movements.

Required: `truck_id`, `driver_id`, `date`, `loads` (≥1)
